user.title: Set up Wisp
user.description: Wisp listens to your Wisp nodes on the local network. Nodes that Home Assistant finds join on their own. To add a node by its address, use Add node on the Wisp integration page.

discovery_confirm.title: Wisp node found
discovery_confirm.description: Set up Wisp with {name} ({host})? Other Wisp nodes on your network join on their own.

abort.node_added: The node was added to Wisp.
abort.not_wisp_node: This device does not run the Wisp node firmware.

user.title: Add a node
user.description: Wisp finds nodes on its own. Add one here if it was not found, for example on another subnet.

data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the node's name in Home Assistant.
data_description.area: Optional. The room the node stands in: its floor is the node's floor for room presence.

data_description.host: Found nodes follow address changes on their own.
data_description.name: Used to name the links this node transmits.
data_description.area: The room the node stands in: its floor is the node's floor for room presence. Nodes without one share a floor.

error.cannot_resolve: This host name could not be found. Try the IP address.
error.no_answer: No Wisp node answered at this address. Check the address and that the node is on.
error.different_node: Another Wisp node answered at this address.

data_description.presence_hold: Seconds a room stays occupied after Wisp last saw someone move in it. Someone sitting still makes little signal.

area_without_floor.message: {area} has no floor, and every Wisp node is on one. Give {area} a floor in its area settings.

no_nodes_on_floor.message: No Wisp node is on {floor}, the floor of {area}. Set the area each node stands in under Wisp, Change node.

floor_without_nodes.message: No Wisp node is on {floor}. Set the area each node stands in under Wisp, Change node.

calibrate_room.name: Calibrate room
calibrate_room.description: Records how the links of the room's floor react while you walk around in the room. Start it in the room and keep moving until it ends; the floor's calibration sensor counts down. Run it again to add samples.

calibrate_empty.name: Calibrate empty floor
calibrate_empty.description: Records the floor with nobody moving on it, so a fan or an access point changing power is not taken for a person. Leave the floor or keep still until it ends.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Optional. Without it, every floor with Wisp nodes records at once. Nodes without a floor share one named after the hub.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds before recording starts, to leave the floor.

clear_calibration.name: Clear calibration
clear_calibration.description: Forgets what Wisp recorded for a room, or for every room and floor. The room's presence sensor goes with it.

area.name: Area
area.description: Optional. Without it, all calibration is cleared.

stop_calibration.name: Stop calibration
stop_calibration.description: Ends a recording before its time is up. What it recorded so far is kept.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Optional. Without it, every recording stops.

few_nodes.title: Few Wisp nodes on {floor}
few_nodes.description: Wisp nodes on {floor}: {count} of at least {needed}. Motion per link works already; room presence and positions need at least {needed} nodes on a floor, and 4 to 6 give clearly better results. Add nodes of the same model, spread around the floor, and set their area to one on {floor}.

few_nodes_home.title: Few Wisp nodes
few_nodes_home.description: Wisp nodes without a floor: {count} of at least {needed}. Motion per link works already; room presence and positions need at least {needed} nodes on a floor, and 4 to 6 give clearly better results. Add nodes of the same model, spread around the floor.
